purpose: Shared behavior fixtures for poc-elastic and ror-elastic. Compare matched document IDs and expected ordering, not exact Elasticsearch _score values.

cases.expect: documents matching either term; documents matching both should normally rank above single-term matches
space is required; adventure is optional
spider matches that do not match horror
Spider-Man phrase results exclude Homecoming; the query must not broaden to unrelated documents
near-match behavior where supported by the query parser and analyzer
all results satisfy the genre filter
all results have vote_average >= 7; browse is sorted by popularity
completion suggestions for the prefix with duplicates removed
accent-folding behavior when corpus contains accented titles
